create_output_file_manager: create an OutputFileManager to handle multiple output files with caching and automatic cleanup
build_data_folder: build a DataFolder to list files, shard across workers, and open files with auto-mkdir support
get_datafolder: get a DataFolder instance from a string path, tuple with filesystem, or tuple with init kwargs
download_file: download a remote file to a local path with an optional progress bar
cached_asset_path_or_download: download a file to a cached local directory only if it hasn't been downloaded already
